I've somewhat hesitatingly voted nay on this, due to a combination of the League's apparent stance towards us, a general sense of fatigue with the endless stream of mediocre Defender commends, and the usual blatant lies that such a narrative entails. Lying truly is the most Defending is capable of, because actually defending is seemingly beyond their reach.

I tend to adopt the stance that I'll vote for a Defender commend if I think it's genuinely merited, such as GK, but I'm not as sold on the League. Maybe a few years down the line, at the moment this is just kind of the same torrent of self-backpatting by Defenders.
This will be a fun IFV to post :Fubugrin: I'll agree I'm not exactly the biggest fan of the moralist machine, but imagine this should pass no problem.
The NSGP crew's aware I already believe the SC's just their political device. I've just accepted that though.
And that was before TL took over the MGC and made it even more so

It will, but we are not presently pursuing any gains in the SC and thus, to my mind, we have the freedom to vote the way we believe we should vote rather than pretend in order to gain backing for our own proposals.
Right on. I'll be keeping an eye on the vote over the weekend. I'll drop this over in FA too so they're aware this is our pending stance.

ignoring political feelings i think there’s an important point to make (which i would put at the center of any IFV i write, if i do write one) that Quebecshire has accomplished a lot of this personally, not the community as a whole
